changelog: Lead Web leads are now clickable — each opens an Activix-style client sheet: bilingual FR/EN deal pipeline (Soumission/Submission, Échange/Exchange, Présentation/Presentation, Vente/Sale, Financement/Financing, Livraison/Delivery), Tasks & Appointments (wired into the real Schedule calendar), Communications log, Notes log, an Offer Browser to link the lead to an actual vehicle from Inventory (pulls real stock#/VIN/price/colors), and general lead info (source, received date, original message).
